theme_strategy.core_vibe: Starbucks Layout Style. Clean, ultra-spacious, editorial feeling, grounded in existing Sacred Ivory & Temple Gold palette.

color_palette.instruction: DO NOT change these colors. They are part of the constraints. Only apply them to the new spatial patterns.

typography.instruction: Redistribute existing fonts to achieve a 'Starbucks' vibe: heavy/bold, tightly tracked headings. Elegant, airy body copy.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-[#5C3A09] leading-none
scale.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#5C3A09] leading-tight
scale.h3: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#6B3410] leading-snug
scale.eyebrow: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#8B2500] mb-4 block

button_system.primary: rounded-full bg-[#FF9933] text-white hover:bg-[#E68A2E] px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:scale-95 inline-flex items-center justify-center
button_system.secondary: rounded-full border-2 border-[#8B2500] text-[#8B2500] hover:bg-[#8B2500] hover:text-white px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95 inline-flex items-center justify-center
button_system.ghost: rounded-full text-[#5C3A09] hover:bg-black/5 px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all active:scale-95 inline-flex items-center justify-center

card_system.default: bg-white border border-[#D4AF37]/20 rounded-3xl p-8 md:p-12 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(92,58,9,0.08)] transition-all

hero.grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 lg:gap-24 items-center max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-12
hero.image_style: rounded-[2.5rem] object-cover h-[50vh] md:h-[70vh] w-full shadow-xl

alternating_sections.wrapper: py-16 md:py-32 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-12
alternating_sections.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 lg:gap-24 items-center
alternating_sections.image_style: rounded-[2rem] object-cover w-full aspect-square md:aspect-[4/5] shadow-lg

full_width_bands.wrapper: w-full relative overflow-hidden py-24 md:py-40 bg-[#5C3A09] text-[#FDFBF7]
full_width_bands.background_image: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover opacity-20 mix-blend-screen (Use existing cosmic-zodiac background here)
full_width_bands.content: relative z-10 max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center px-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center

specific_page_recipes.Landing: Hero (Left text, right large rounded image) -> Alternating Value Props -> Full-Width Atmospheric Band with cosmic background -> Testimonials in minimalistic white cards -> Clean Footer.
specific_page_recipes.Pricing: Massive whitespace header -> 3-column grid for tiers. Free (Minimal card), Basic (White card, subtle gold border), Premium (Dark card, bg-[#5C3A09] text-white).
specific_page_recipes.Basic_Tier_Form: Centered layout. max-w-2xl mx-auto. Inputs: Shadcn UI heavily customized to have rounded-full or minimal border-b styling. Saffron pill button.
specific_page_recipes.Basic_Tier_Results: Large Kundali D1 chart centered. AI advice in clean, large typography (text-xl leading-relaxed). Planetary positions in a clean table (no vertical dividers, ample padding).
specific_page_recipes.Premium_Tier: Long scrollytelling format. D1/Chandra/Navamsha charts in clean grids. Alternating sections for Numerology. Numerology Dasha timeline with vertical connecting lines and pill-shaped markers.
specific_page_recipes.Readings_Archive: List: Clean rows, border-b border-[#5C3A09]/10, hover:bg-black/5. Detail: Reading title massive (text-5xl), content narrow readable max-w-3xl column.
specific_page_recipes.Admin: Tabs customized as pill toggles. Tables must be edge-to-edge on mobile, rounded-xl on desktop with generous cell padding (p-4).
specific_page_recipes.Auth: Split screen layout. Left side: beautiful full-height cosmic/meditation image. Right side: Login/Register form perfectly centered with lots of white space.
specific_page_recipes.Book_Consultation: Calendar slot picker centered max-w-3xl. Time slots rendered as secondary outline pill buttons.

navigation_and_footer.navbar: Sticky, z-50, backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 border-b border-[#5C3A09]/5. Links: text-[#5C3A09] font-medium hover:text-[#FF9933]. Use small Saffron pill for CTA.
navigation_and_footer.footer: py-24 bg-white border-t border-[#5C3A09]/10. Clean minimalist grid. Bottom features a massive subtle brand text overlay.

constraints_what_not_to_change: DO NOT change existing color palette (Cream/Ivory bg, bronze-gold text, saffron CTAs).
DO NOT remove the existing cosmic-zodiac background image; use it elegantly in full_width_bands.
MUST preserve all data-testid attributes for testing.
DO NOT alter KundaliChart SVG drawing logic.
iconography: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5. No emojis.
components: Customize Shadcn UI at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ to adopt rounded corners (rounded-full for buttons, rounded-2xl/3xl for cards/dialogs).
